summary: Original raw-model and failed-worker-handoff defects are corrected and their exact adapted reproductions pass on both Python versions. All166 focused tests pass each. findings.title: SCAFFOLD report callbacks bypass the promised batch failure boundary.
findings.related_first_review: F27-R01: original raw NaN/missing/broadcast reproductions are fixed; callback and abort-state coverage remains incomplete.
findings.cause: weights_received validates raw halves and installs pending controls, but the SCAFFOLD subclass has no rejection cleanup around inherited _process_reports. The receive callback can raise or invalidate the returned model after validation. Only sample metadata is rechecked afterward. Model and controls commit before on_weights_aggregated callbacks run.

steps: Use the actual shipped TOML with explicit CPU, scalar float64, plain SGD, eta=.1, N=3 overrides and a full report obtained from successful real example training.
Initial server x=1,c=2; submit two num_samples=2 reports with model theta=[7],[9] and finite control deltas [3],[4].
Register a normal ServerCallback that raises in on_weights_received; call actual server._process_reports(). Then call it again with invalid num_samples=-1.
Separately register a callback that invalidates sample metadata, a callback that raises in on_weights_aggregated, and a callback that fills a returned theta tensor with NaN.
reproducer.expected: Each failed batch preserves x=1,c=2 and clears pending/received controls. A model invalidated between validation and aggregation must be rejected before either commit.
reproducer.actual: Receive failure and callback-induced metadata failure leave _pending_control_variate and received_client_control_variates populated. A later ingress sample error also leaves the stale stage. Aggregation callback failure raises after x=8,c=13/3 commit. Callback mutation of the cloned model to NaN completes without an exception and commits x=NaN,c=13/3. Raw inbound payloads remain unmodified.

findings.bounded_correction: Keep the correction in the SCAFFOLD example boundary: discard staged controls on every unsuccessful report batch, validate the model/control state actually used after receive callbacks, and restore/defer the batch model/control commit when an aggregation callback fails. Add real _process_reports callback regressions. No global FedAvg rewrite, external side-effect transaction, optimizer/server restart or whole federated round rollback is required.

findings.title: Direct train_model accepts and persists controls before its fallible end lifecycle.
findings.related_first_review: F27-R02: original missing-worker handoff/reuse/retry regression is fixed; direct lifecycle failure remains an unclosed acceptance boundary.
findings.cause: train_model calls on_train_result_accepted and marks successful before training_step_strategy.on_train_end runs in finally. If that public end hook raises, model-update cleanup at the next line is skipped. Canonical ci has already advanced, _result_accepted remains true, and the optimizer pre-hook remains installed. The deferred train_process path correctly rejects the same error through its outer catch, exposing inconsistent direct/process behavior.

steps: Use the actual SCAFFOLD trainer, scalar quadratic data, x=1,c=2,old ci=1, eta=.1, two real updates; test both existing canonical ci=1 and absent canonical file.
Inject a GradientAccumulationStepStrategy subclass whose public on_train_end calls the ordinary end hook and then raises RuntimeError.
Call direct trainer.train_model. Inspect the canonical file, strategy ci, outbound delta eligibility and optimizer hook.
Perform ordinary configure-based 1->2->1 reuse and fresh reconstruction. Remove the injected failure and successfully retry the same inbound x,c.
Compare the exact same injected lifecycle failure through direct train_process.
reproducer.expected: An end-hook error rejects the result: retain prior ci=1, preserve the existing file bytes or absence, refuse outbound delta, and release step hooks. With existing ci=1, routine reuse/reconstruction and successful retry yield y=.62,ci=.9,delta=-.1.
reproducer.actual: Direct train_model raises but persists ci=.9 even when the file was absent, leaves outbound get_update_payload usable, and retains the optimizer pre-hook. Reuse and reconstruction load .9. Successful retry yields y=.601,ci=.895,delta=-.005. train_process rejects the same error and preserves ci=1/file bytes or absence; its existing-canonical retry yields .62/.9/-.1.

findings.numerical_consequence: For inactive controls (3,2), after only the successful erroneous retry delta is delivered, server c becomes 1.9983333333333335 while mean retained controls is 1.965. This is ordinary client reuse plus retry, not a full restart requirement or convergence claim.
findings.impact: The newly introduced generic acceptance hook still permits a failed direct call to become durable and outbound-eligible. The same caller-visible error has different acceptance effects across the supported direct and process entrypoints.
findings.bounded_correction: Run the fallible training-step end lifecycle before direct acceptance and guarantee model-update rejection cleanup plus context/optimizer-hook cleanup even if another end hook raises. Preserve the deferred model-save/current-token worker ordering. Add the direct/process failure comparison with successful retry; no general restart or new algorithm framework is required.

Additional float32 cast-overflow and integer-control rejection cases pass at either payload position and zero/positive sample weight.

Actual shipped spawn positive pipeline and missing/stale/model-save/parent-commit negative cases pass. Exact original ci1 missing-handoff -> reuse/fresh/retry .62/.9/-.1 passes. Reused inbound/outbound processors consume current server controls and clear stale values. Direct/process lifecycle inconsistency F27-R2-02 remains.

Independent rational oracle, real client gradients, full actual _process_reports and next server payloads pass for direct uneven/equal-count cases and actual multiprocessing spawn. Round1 x1.19,c2/3; round2 x10209/10000,c896/1125. Inactive ci retained; c=mean(allci). Unequal model weighting is a documented extension.

Original NaN/missing/broadcast raw models now reject before commit. Delivered28 malformed-model+6 metadata cases and5 malformed-delta cases pass, plus independent12 dtype/control cases and compatible bool/integer/frozen transport case. F27-R2-01 remains: callback failure leaves stale stages or returns failure after commit; callback-modified malformed model can bypass validation.

Unchanged momentum.9 lr.01/weight_decay0 and constant-rate Adam match independently stepped raw optimizers followed by -eta*(c-ci), warning once. V2 shares corrected OptionII; no OptionI/mean-gradient/convergence claim for extensions.

166 delivered focused tests pass each on3.13.16/3.14.8; Ruff import policy passes. Exact immutable identities and author523/17/startup receipts verified. Material boundary findings require original-author correction, another fresh code review, and final source/prose reconciliation. Missing prose in this worktree is not a finding.
